rules.label: Application Config
rules.description: Informational only: the editor never matches an empty rule path (configEditorService _matchRuleScore), so closed/required/label here do not apply. The root label comes from the map's top-level label.

rules.label: HTTP Port
rules.description: TCP port the HTTP server listens on

rules.label: Developer Access
rules.description: Enable loopback-only development routes authenticated by secure.config.json devLoginKey. Read per request; no restart needed. Default off (unset).

rules.label: Default Grok Model
rules.description: Default model ID for Grok chat requests. When empty, grokService falls back to grok-4-fast-reasoning and the native xAI path / quips fall back to grok-4.3.

rules.label: Debug NovelAI
rules.description: Verbose logging in the NovelAI client. Applied when the client is created (startup). Default off.

rules.label: Explore Uploads Enabled
rules.description: Allow Publish to Explorer (POST explore.novelai.net/post/image). Keep false until upload flow is verified safe.

rules.label: Log Verbosity
rules.description: Console log detail level (modules/logger.js VERBOSITY_LEVELS). Default NORMAL. Read once at startup. The LOG_VERBOSITY environment variable is also consulted.

rules.label: Preload Tags
rules.description: Load tag search services during boot instead of lazily. Read once at startup. Default off.

rules.label: Sequenzia Upload Folder
rules.description: Filesystem path for Sequenzia/NovelAI upload integration

rules.label: User-Agent
rules.description: User-Agent for some outbound HTTP calls (Grok service and dynamic-generation fetches). When empty, each call site uses its own fallback (StaticForge/1.1a or a browser UA).

rules.label: PM2 Log Name
rules.description: Fallback name used to locate PM2 log files (<name>-out.log / <name>-error.log) for the log viewer. Does not rename the PM2 process; under PM2 the process's own name (ecosystem.config.js: Dreamscape) wins. Fallbacks: Dreamscape, staticforge.

rules.label: Public Hostname
rules.description: Host[:port] WITHOUT scheme (example: staticforge.737.jp.net). Used for the MCP base URL and OAuth issuer; localhost/127.0.0.1 select http, anything else https. Default localhost:9220. Read per call.

rules.label: MCP Request Log
rules.description: Log one stdout line per MCP JSON-RPC call (method, tool, actor, IP, status, duration). Default on. Never logs arguments or the MCP path UUID.

rules.label: MCP Local Sandbox Root
rules.description: If set, MCP dest_path writes go under this directory. Empty (default) disables local writes so callers download the artifact URL onto their own machine.

rules.label: Weather Cache Size
rules.description: Max entries. Seeded default 100 (code fallback 500 if 0/unset).

rules.label: Location Cache Size
rules.description: Max entries. Seeded default 100 (code fallback 50 if 0/unset).

rules.label: Weather TTL (ms)
rules.description: Milliseconds. Seeded default 300000 (code fallback 180000).

rules.label: Location TTL (ms)
rules.description: Milliseconds. Seeded default 300000 (code fallback 86400000).

rules.label: Weather Failure TTL (ms)
rules.description: Milliseconds. Seeded default 150000 (code fallback 900000).

rules.label: Auto Recompile Assets
rules.description: Rebuild runtime assets automatically when sources change

rules.label: Auto Launch Workspace
rules.description: Open desktop mode with the active workspace on load

rules.label: Custom Start Label
rules.description: Up to 24 characters when preset is custom

rules.label: Start Menu Pinned Items
rules.description: Applet IDs pinned to the start menu (max 48)

rules.label: Elevate Pins
rules.description: How strongly NAXT elevates pinned/favorite tags in search (0–3)

rules.label: Result Type Filter
rules.description: Restrict autofill results to one type; null (default) shows all.

rules.label: Artist Search
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Remote Access (MCP)
rules.description: MCP generation defaults (modules/remoteAccessSettings.js).

rules.label: Default Generation Method
rules.description: Default studio.

rules.label: Auto Generate
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Open Generated Images In
rules.description: Default ledge.

rules.label: Min Prints per Turn
rules.description: 1-8, default 1.

rules.label: Max Prints per Turn
rules.description: 1-8, default 8; raised to min if lower.

rules.label: Image Generation
rules.description: Studio output prefs (modules/imageGenerationSettings.js).

rules.label: Stream Image Generation
rules.description: Default true.

rules.label: Show Streamed Images Unprocessed
rules.description: Default true.

rules.label: Simple Output Viewer
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Lock Output Viewer Camera
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Reduced Motion
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Transparency Background
rules.description: Default checker-dark.

rules.label: Transparency Custom Color
rules.description: #rrggbb or #rgb; default #808080.

rules.label: Hide Quickstart Gallery
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Persist History
rules.description: Default true.

rules.label: Image Format
rules.description: Default png.

rules.label: Automatic Download
rules.description: Default false.

rules.label: Alpha Mode
rules.description: Default straight.

rules.label: Generation Quips (Scheduler)
rules.description: Server scheduler and session settings only — quip text content lives in SQLite, not JSON

rules.label: Daily Check Hour
rules.description: Local hour (0–23) for time-based quip auto-update checks. Default 8.

rules.label: Daily Check Minute
rules.description: Local minute (0–59) for time-based quip auto-update checks. Default 0.

rules.label: Count Check Interval (hours)
rules.description: Hours between count-based auto-update evaluations (1–24). Default 4.

rules.label: Maintain Quip Session
rules.description: Reuse the same Grok session across quip generation runs. Default true.

rules.label: Break Session at 128k
rules.description: Start a fresh session when context nears 128k tokens. Default true.

rules.label: Log Full Prompts
rules.description: Log full sent messages and model output to console during quip runs. Default false.

rules.label: Checkpoints
rules.description: Tiered retention for config/database checkpoint snapshots

rules.label: Tiered Retention (Grandfathering)
rules.description: When true (default), checkpoint cleanup uses the hour/day/month grandfathering tiers below. When false, checkpoints are still created but cleanup falls back to a fixed newest-N cap.

rules.label: Hour Tier Max
rules.description: Number of hourly buckets kept (default 4); older buckets roll over or are deleted. 0 purges ALL hour-tier checkpoints.

rules.label: Hour Rollover Target
rules.description: Tier that receives excess hour checkpoints. null (default) deletes them.

rules.label: Hour Per-Bucket Max
rules.description: Newest snapshots kept within the same hour bucket (default 1)

rules.label: Day Tier Max
rules.description: Number of daily buckets kept. Default 0 = day tier disabled (its checkpoints are purged).

rules.label: Day Rollover Target
rules.description: Tier that receives excess day checkpoints. null (default) deletes them.

rules.label: Day Per-Bucket Max
rules.description: Newest snapshots kept within the same day bucket (default 1)

rules.label: Month Tier Max
rules.description: Number of monthly buckets kept. Default 0 = month tier disabled (its checkpoints are purged).

rules.label: Month Rollover Target
rules.description: Last tier: null (default) deletes the oldest month checkpoints.

rules.label: Month Per-Bucket Max
rules.description: Newest snapshots kept within the same month bucket (default 1, minimum 1)

rules.label: Per-Resource Overrides
rules.description: Retention overrides merged over grandfathering, keyed by resource: JSON config file stem (e.g. config, prompt.config), database checkpoint name, or bundles.

rules.label: User PIN Login Enabled
rules.description: Allow the read-only user PIN to log in and approve MCP OAuth consent. Default true (only an explicit false disables). Admin PIN is unaffected.

rules.label: Use Vista Logon
rules.description: Desktop logon starts at the Vista winlogon screen, and the logon tool windows and the Preparing desktop window use Vista Basic. Default false (Windows Classic logon). Set from User Accounts; sent on /status.

rules.label: Apocrypha Reader
rules.description: Public zine Grim visibility. Default trustedProxies and localCidrs are loopback only. The reverse-proxy socket peer MUST be listed in trustedProxies or XFF is ignored (and an untrusted private peer with XFF is treated as not local).

rules.label: Trusted Proxies
rules.description: IPs/CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For is honored (rightmost untrusted hop). Default 127.0.0.0/8 and ::1. Add the proxy peer Dreamscape actually sees.

rules.label: Local CIDRs
rules.description: IPs/CIDRs that count as local for Grim. Default loopback only. Add the LAN subnet on the host; do not put the public internet or an unlisted proxy hop here.

rules.label: Local Grim
rules.description: When true (default), Grim is shown to local CIDRs as well as logged-in sessions. When false, Grim is session-only.

rules.label: Xi
rules.description: Host-side Director persona. Stays off until enabled on this instance.

rules.label: Enable Xi
rules.description: Show the Wren / Xi switch and run Xi on the host. A server start is required.

rules.label: Xi Workspace
rules.description: Folder Xi edits. Empty, or a path that does not exist, falls back to this repo.

rules.label: Autofill Ranking
rules.description: Autofill scoring constants (modules/autofillRankingSettings.js). Prefer the Autofill Ranking applet: it bumps rankingVersion and applies live. Edits here only take effect at next start.

rules.label: Max Tracked Suspicious IPs
rules.description: Cap on the in-memory suspicious-IP table; oldest 10% pruned when exceeded. Default 5000.

rules.label: Guacamole Remote
rules.description: Fallback only. Precedence: GUAC_* env, then secure.config guacUsername/guacPassword, then this block, then the Komaki console config. Prefer secure.config for credentials.

rules.label: Guacamole Password
rules.description: Credential. Prefer secure.config.json guacPassword.

rules.label: Grimoire Browser
rules.description: Enabled only when origin and token are both set. Env GRIMOIRE_BROWSER_* and secure.config grimoireBrowserToken take precedence.

rules.label: Grimoire Browser Token
rules.description: Bearer credential. Prefer secure.config.json grimoireBrowserToken.

rules.label: Mail Gateway
rules.description: Inbound SMTP/LMTP and outbound submission for <bot>.<dept>@dream.737.jp.net. Off until enabled. tifa and pyra stay unmapped until a department is confirmed.

rules.label: Enable Mail Gateway
rules.description: Start the inbound SMTP/LMTP listener and allow outbound rewrite. Default off.

rules.label: Public Mail Domain
rules.description: Domain for mapped addresses. Default dream.737.jp.net.

rules.label: Inbound Port
rules.description: SMTP/LMTP listen port. Default 2525. Only 192.168.255.1 is accepted.

rules.label: Inbound Bind Address
rules.description: Listen address. Default 192.168.200.101 (dreamscape vlan10 toward 192.168.255.1). Not 0.0.0.0.

rules.label: Inbound Allowlist
rules.description: Peer IPs allowed to connect. Default 192.168.255.1 (LANTIS Postfix).

rules.label: Max Concurrent Connections
rules.description: Inbound connection cap. Extra peers get 421. Default 16.

rules.label: Session Timeout (ms)
rules.description: Absolute session lifetime, independent of idle. Default 120000.

rules.label: Idle Timeout (ms)
rules.description: Close a quiet socket. Default 30000.

rules.label: Max DATA Bytes
rules.description: Oversize DATA is discarded until <CRLF>.<CRLF>, then 552. Default 10 MiB.

rules.label: TLS Mode
rules.description: starttls on 587 (default) or implicit TLS on 465. STARTTLS must be offered; there is no plaintext fallback.

rules.label: TLS Server Name
rules.description: Hostname checked on the certificate. Default mx.dream.737.jp.net.

rules.label: TLS CA Path
rules.description: Optional extra CA file. Empty uses the system store. A Let's Encrypt cert is expected for mx.dream.737.jp.net.

rules.label: Outbound Rate Limit
rules.description: Per-bot outbound messages per minute. Default 30. 0 disables.

rules.label: Outbound Recipient Allowlist
rules.description: Optional. Empty allows any external recipient. Entries are an address, a domain, or @domain.

rules.label: Mailbox Map
rules.description: local-part on dream.737.jp.net → Dovecote mailbox. Shipped: yukimi; sala.ops; menma/rook/cursor/claude/frost .dev; hoshino.apocrypha; ivory.studio; guren.lab; chiyo.web. Yukimi is yukimi@dream.737.jp.net only — never ykazari@icloud.com or any external domain. tifa and pyra stay unmapped.

rules.label: Inbound Spam Headers
rules.description: Header names the inbound path trusts when filing to Spam. Only the topmost instance above the relay's Received. File on X-Spam-Flag YES, X-Spam-Status Yes, or trusted A-R dmarc=fail with p=quarantine / dis=QUARANTINE. DKIM fail, dmarc p=none, and Received-SPF are stored as auth info only.

rules.label: Spam Flag Header
rules.description: Default X-Spam-Flag. Only the topmost instance is trusted. YES files to Spam; NO never rescues.

rules.label: Spam Status Header
rules.description: Default X-Spam-Status. Format Yes|No, score=N required=5.0 tests=…. A leading Yes files to Spam. score and required are parsed for display only.

rules.label: Authentication-Results Header
rules.description: Default Authentication-Results. Only the topmost instance whose authserv-id matches the configured relay id is trusted. dmarc=fail with p=quarantine or dis=QUARANTINE files to Spam. dkim=fail and dmarc p=none are display-only.

rules.label: Received-SPF Header
rules.description: Default Received-SPF. Topmost instance only. Stored and shown as auth info. fail / permerror / softfail / neutral / none never file to Spam (hard fails are rejected upstream).

rules.label: Spam Report Header
rules.description: Default X-Spam-Report. Stored and shown on the message. Never used to file to Spam.

rules.label: Relay authserv-id
rules.description: Relay authserv-id. Default mx.dream.737.jp.net. Only the topmost Authentication-Results with this id is trusted. Empty trusts no Authentication-Results (X-Spam-* / Received-SPF still apply).

rules.label: Pending Mailboxes
rules.description: tifa and pyra: department still to be decided. Leave unmapped. Do not add them to mailboxes until confirmed.

rules.label: NovelAI API Key (legacy)
rules.description: Legacy fallback read by searchService when no managed key is available. Prefer secure.config.json key lists.
